text:
Lena (Product): quick huddle: customer Xeno wants a private-onramp pilot with VPC isolation, HSM keys, and a non-negotiable latency SLA (p95 < 200ms). need end-to-end dependency map + gating checklist.
Omar (Eng Runtime): runtime items: 1) fast KV resume to avoid cold-starts, 2) quantized model variant for the pilot, 3) perf harness for their sample prompts. estimate: 10 dev-days.
Sam (Infra): infra needs: subnet peering, route table approval, 1 reserved A100 for pilot window, and bastion/ops access flow. will need customer's CIDR + egress policy.
Dee (Security): HSM integration checklist: keywrap flow, audit logging, rotation policy, and assurance we don't persist plaintext keys anywhere. threat model required before greenlight.
Kai (SRE): rollout ops: prewarm strategy + autoscaler guardrails, plus a small canary (5% traffic) and a fail-open fallback to hosted model. monitoring: p50/p95/p99, traffic split, KMS error spikes.
Maya (Solutions): onboarding doc must include cert exchange steps, smoke tests with exact curl commands, and a clear rollback checklist. also customer will expect a runbook they can follow.
Lena (Product): propose gate list — please call out owners and realistic dates: 
- Security review & HSM signoff (owner: Dee)
- CIDR + cert exchange complete (owner: Maya)
- Reserved GPU confirmed (owner: Sam)
- Runtime perf: p95 < 200ms on pilot dataset (owner: Omar)
- Canary + rollback tested (owner: Kai)
Omar (Eng Runtime): add: runtime must support per-tenant cache namespace. I'll prototype namespace switcher by Thu.
Sam (Infra): I can confirm GPU reservation after we get the CIDR; tentatively reserve for pilot window starting in 3 weeks.
Dee (Security): I can run threat model Thu afternoon. need details on control-plane endpoints and who has admin keys.
Kai (SRE): autoscaler change: add prewarm hook that triggers when anticipated burst > 300 RPS. can demo policy tomorrow.
Maya (Solutions): I'll collect CIDR/cert today and push onboarding draft to this thread by EOD.
Lena (Product): timeline ask: pilot kickoff target = 21 days. if anyone sees blockers call them out now.
Omar (Eng Runtime): 21 days is tight but doable if infra and security don't block. request 1 FTE for two weeks to parallelize perf tuning.
Dee (Security): note: HSM vendor paperwork may add 5 business days; flagging as potential timeline risk.
Sam (Infra): :thumbsup: on owners; Sam will follow up with procurement for GPU reservation.
Kai (SRE): I'll start dashboard templates and the canary playbook.
Lena (Product): action items recap: 
- Dee: threat model + HSM signoff (due: Thu)
- Maya: collect CIDR/certs + onboarding doc (due: today EOD)
- Sam: reserve GPU + peering plan (due: tomorrow EOD)
- Omar: perf prototype + namespace switcher (PR by Wed)
- Kai: canary + autoscaler policy draft (demo tomorrow)
OpsBot: reminder set for 1779004800 (4h) to check progress.
Maya (Solutions): tagging Xeno contact for cert exchange now.
Lena (Product): ok — react with :white_check_mark: if you accept owners/dates or reply with blockers.
Sam (Infra): :white_check_mark:
Omar (Eng Runtime): :white_check_mark:
Dee (Security): :white_check_mark: (pending Thu sync)
Kai (SRE): :white_check_mark:

Lena (Product): thanks all. I'll escalate HSM vendor queue if Dee flags delay. ping me directly for urgent blocks. :rocket:
